items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: George Reed, the drummer, and Dan Mastry, bass player, they said Watch it! Look out! ... With Red Richards, Vic Dickenson, Herman Autrey, Woodie Powell, Dan Mastry, and George Reed.

ctx.x: So now we're wa-a-a-y-y in the hell up in the mountains, clear up in the Alps, I mean, snowing and ice, and everything, and the wind was blowing, and it almost blew us off the damn thing, and the man went to sleep. Went to sleep, and George Reed, the drummer, and Dan Mastry, bass player, they said Watch it! Look out! And started screaming, and he came to himself, and the guys said man, pull over. Pull over there.

Well, there's too many miles in between here and some of those places you named then, and 200 and 300 miles, all that kind of stuff. That's -- a man can't do all that and he worked last night, and I mean naturally, we're in the bus. We're sleeping, we can -- or nod, trying to, but when you're driving you don't close an eye. You don't bat an eye. You've got to keep awake.
